verifications.claim: Samsung is discontinuing its proprietary Samsung Messages app in July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July 2026" (R1); "Samsung will discontinue its Messages app in July 2026" (R2); "discontinue its native messaging app in July 2026" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm discontinuation of Samsung Messages in July 2026.

verifications.claim: Samsung is transitioning entirely to Google Messages as the default texting application on all Galaxy devices.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "transitioning to Google Messages" (R1); "Google Messages will replace Samsung Messages" (R2); "recommends switching to Google Messages" (R3); but "Devices running Android 11 or lower remain unaffected" (R2); "support multiple SMS apps" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: References support transition to Google Messages as default/recommended, but not 'entirely' or 'on all' devices due to exceptions for Android 11 or lower and allowance of alternatives.

verifications.claim: Samsung has been moving toward Google Messages for years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "began transitioning toward Google Messages as early as 2021" (R6); "Back in 2024, Samsung stopped pre-installing" (R2); "The signs were there... hints about it from a time to time" (R3); "Google Messages has been the default... for a bit now" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Samsung's multi-year shift starting 2021-2024.

verifications.claim: Many newer devices already use Google Messages as the default.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Google Messages has been the default messaging app on Galaxy devices for a bit now" (R7, R2); "newer Galaxy phones, like the Samsung Galaxy S26 series" (R1); "Samsung's more recent Galaxy S26" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: References explicitly confirm Google Messages as default on newer/recent Galaxy devices.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages app is not being preinstalled on new devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Samsung stopped allowing Samsung Messages to be downloaded on their newer Galaxy phones" (R1); "stopped pre-installing its Messages app on flagship Galaxy devices" (R2); "owners of Samsung's latest Galaxy 26 lineup... cannot download" (R5); "The Galaxy S26 can't download the Samsung Messages app" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation that Samsung Messages is not preinstalled or downloadable on new devices like S26.

verifications.claim: In July 2026, the Samsung Messages app will no longer be able to send or receive messages, except for emergencies, on many Galaxy phones.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "no longer send or receive texts, unless for emergency numbers or emergency contacts" (R1); "will not send texts except for emergency contacts and services" (R2); "use the app even after... for emergency service numbers or emergency contacts" (R3); "only messaging to emergency services will work" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Precise match across references for post-July 2026 functionality limited to emergencies on affected (Android 12+) Galaxy phones.

verifications.claim: Users on older operating systems (Android 11 or lower) are generally not affected
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Not affected (for now) are devices running Android 11 or older" (R1); "Devices running Android 11 or lower remain unaffected" (R2); "continue to function on devices running Android 11 or lower" (R3); "Users of older Android operating systems (dating back to Android 11 or older) will not be impacted" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant references directly state Android 11 or lower devices/users are not affected.
